messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We have looked at your request carefully for our shop. We can offer you a price of €36.00 per unit. 

We always aim to deliver top quality from our machines for your orders, and we look forward to working together on this project. Let us know if this works for you.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (2)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding rfq: pump shaft for the new hx series.
We hold a competing offer at 31.00 EUR per unit (offer:70250-1).
We can work with your lead time of 28 days.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 4,200 pcs per year over 24 months.
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (2)
messages.body:
Hallo,

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

I can go down to 30.00 EUR, but I absolutely need to keep payment at 30 days as cash is tight. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot is a price of €30.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Let me know if we have a deal at these terms.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (4)
messages.body: Thank you for your offer. We are completing our evaluation of all offers and will come back to you shortly. Could you confirm your earliest lead time?

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (4)
messages.body:
Hallo,

Good to speak with you again. We have free capacity for your parts in our shop. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Here are the terms of our Angebot: a price of €28.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. Our Lieferzeit is 28 days. As we offered, our earliest lead time is 28 days. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium. 

Let me know when you have completed your evaluation.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
